about: Every reason a Sorta add-on package can be refused. The kit's check.py, and the iOS and Android checkers, give the same code for the same package. rules.md says the order the checks run in.

reasons.meaning: The file isn't a zip Sorta can read: no end record, a ZIP64 or split archive, an unknown compression method, a damaged entry or a wrong CRC.
An entry name is empty, too long, absolute, has a backslash, a drive letter, a '.' or '..' part, or a character outside A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', '-' and '/'.
An entry is a symbolic link.
Two entries have the same name.
Two entry names differ only in upper and lower case.
An entry is encrypted.
An entry, or the whole archive, unpacks to more than 100 times its packed size.
The archive has more than 200 entries.
The archive is over 512 KB, or its files add up to more than 1 MB.
A file isn't one of the allowed kinds: manifest.json, .js, .json, README.md, LICENSE, LICENSE.txt, LICENSE.md or CHANGELOG.md. Hidden files and folder entries count as not allowed.
A file is more than two folders deep.
A file isn't UTF-8 text, or has a NUL byte.
The manifest's main isn't a .js file in the package.
The main file is over 256 KB.
There's no manifest.json at the top of the package.
manifest.json isn't valid JSON, isn't one object, names a key twice, or has a field the format doesn't define.
format isn't "sorta-addon".
formatVersion isn't 1.
id isn't a reverse-DNS name of 3 to 64 characters from a-z, 0-9, '.' and '-', with at least one dot and no empty part.
id is com.cramdown or starts with com.cramdown., which are Sorta's own.
name isn't 1 to 30 characters, has a control character, or starts or ends with a space.
version isn't a semantic version without build metadata.
minSorta isn't a semantic version without build metadata.
api isn't a whole number from 1 to 99.
author isn't a name and an https:// url and nothing else, or its name has an @, or its url has a user name.
license isn't an SPDX id on the OSI's list.
permissions isn't a list of known permissions, names one twice, or asks for both ideas.read and ideas.read.folder.
hosts is missing while net is asked for, is given without net, or has an entry that isn't an exact lowercase host name.
contributes.commands isn't 1 to 5 commands, each with its own id and a title of 1 to 30 characters.
contributes has an unknown field, doesn't match the permissions, or has a card view, settings file or board palette that breaks its rules.
At install only: api is newer than the app's API.
At install only: minSorta is above the app's version.
